requirements.text: CNC machining cell with robot loader

messages.text: Add a CNC machining cell with a robot loader in the empty west bay, plus a tool rack. Keep a forklift aisle to the entrance.
Can the cell get its own emergency exit through the south wall?

questions.question: The emergency exit cuts an existing wall that may be load-bearing. Approve, subject to a structural engineer check?

validation.profile: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 general industry + NFPA 101 industrial egress — demo subset

issues.message: Emergency exit cuts into existing wall Wall C; it may be load-bearing.
issues.fix: Structural engineer to confirm and specify lintel/needling before cutting. Ask the user to sign off.

issues.message: Guard fence north is only stable once tied in; it falls at 0.05 g while free-standing.
issues.fix: Prop/brace during construction until ties and head restraint are complete.

issues.message: Guard fence east is only stable once tied in; it falls at 0.05 g while free-standing.
issues.fix: Prop/brace during construction until ties and head restraint are complete.

issues.fix: Prop/brace during construction until ties and head restraint are complete.

issues.fix: Prop/brace during construction until ties and head restraint are complete.

next_steps.title: Tape-check one dimension and rescale the scan
next_steps.why: Video-only scale assumes a 1.5 m phone height; confirm before setting out.

next_steps.title: Structural check of the south wall for the emergency exit
next_steps.why: Opening cuts an existing wall of unknown structural role; lintel to be specified.

next_steps.title: Slab check and anchor design for the 6 t CNC mill
next_steps.why: Tilt test shows about 21 kN anchor demand at 0.25 g; confirm slab thickness and bolt pattern.

next_steps.title: Order guard fence with interlocked 1.0 m gate
next_steps.why: Guarding for mill and robot (29 CFR 1910.212); gate sized for egress.

next_steps.title: Anchor tool rack before loading
next_steps.why: Free-standing rack tips over at 0.25 g in the physics check.

next_steps.title: Brace fence runs until both ends are fixed
next_steps.why: Fence panels fall at 0.05 g while free-standing during installation.

next_steps.title: Mark the 3 m forklift aisle and keep it clear
next_steps.why: Route from the entrance to the cell must stay unobstructed.

agent_note: Waiting for your sign-off on the emergency exit
